findings.rule: Set an explicit timeout on fetch calls.

source.quote: Always set an explicit timeout on fetch calls. Keep AbortSignal.timeout(5000): without it an upstream stall holds a worker forever. This fixes incident #41.
source.author: ava

findings.rule: Use the structured logger instead of console.log.

source.quote: Use the structured logger; never console.log in server code.
source.author: ava

findings.rule: Reuse the same idempotency key across retries.

source.quote: Keep the same idempotency key across retries; never generate randomUUID inside a retry callback.
source.author: mina

findings.rule: Give opening fenced code blocks a language tag.

source.quote: Always give fenced code blocks a language tag for accessible syntax highlighting.
source.author: mina

data.coverage: Added lines only. Single-line fetch/retry calls and diff-visible Markdown fence state. Findings are review suggestions; complex or multiline constructs need human review.
